description: This file defines a native MSSQL driver for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP, including classes for database connection and recordset handling, along with various methods for database schema operations, transaction controls, and error handling.

classes.name: ADODB_mssqlnative
classes.description: Represents the native MSSQL database connection driver, providing methods for connecting, querying, schema management, transaction control, and database version handling.

classes.name: ADORecordset_mssqlnative
classes.description: Represents the recordset returned from queries executed through the MSSQL native driver, with methods for fetching data, moving through result sets, and retrieving metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the ADODB_mssqlnative class, initializes error handling and logging based on debug flag.

methods.name: ServerVersion
methods.description: Detects and stores the version of the connected SQL Server instance, supporting only versions 2005 and newer.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns an array with server description and version information.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns an SQL expression for handling null values with ISNULL function.

methods.name: enableLastInsertID
methods.description: Enables or disables retrieval of last inserted ID after insert operations.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last ID generated by an IDENTITY column.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence object; defaults to old or new syntax based on server version.

methods.name: CreateSequence2008
methods.description: Creates a sequence in SQL Server 2005/2008 using a table as sequence simulation.

methods.name: CreateSequence2012
methods.description: Creates a sequence object using SQL Server 2012+ SEQUENCE feature.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates the next sequence number, selecting appropriate method based on server version.

methods.name: GenID2008
methods.description: Generates sequence number for SQL Server 2008+ by updating a sequence table.

methods.name: GenID2012
methods.description: Generates sequence number for SQL Server 2012+ using NEXT VALUE FOR.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Returns SQL string for date formatting based on supplied date format.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Locks specified rows in tables for transaction consistency.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Switches active database context.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves current error messages from the last operation.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Retrieves error code of the last error.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the SQL Server instance with given credentials.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection (or fallback to regular if not supported).

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement; returns the raw SQL string as preparation is not managed.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Creates an SQL string concatenation expression suited for MSSQL.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates BLOB or CLOB fields with binary data.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement, handling insert ID retrieval if configured.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection and frees resources.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints information.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Returns a list of user databases on the server.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Returns primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of tables, potentially filtered by mask.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns SQL for substring operation on a field.

methods.name: charMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size for character data types (no limit).

methods.name: textMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size for text data types (no limit).

methods.name: metaProcedures
methods.description: Gets list of stored procedures and routines.

methods.name: offsetDate
methods.description: Returns SQL expression to add fractional days to a date.
